title: nan
authors: Tang J.; Chen Y.; Niu X.; Wang L.; Chen L.; Liu J.; Shi C.; Hyyppä J.
key_contribution: Presents a LiDAR scan-matching-aided INS integrated with a loosely coupled EKF for GNSS-denied environments, achieving centimetre-level positioning accuracy in field tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
